operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: Graph construction creates nodes and weighted edges from biological inputs; the compared primitives partition, concatenate, add, align, and reshape do not represent graph assembly.
Graph construction creates cell-specific nodes and edges; the compared primitives do not represent construction of an interaction graph.
AML graph construction is a network-assembly computation not represented by the compared sequence, aggregation, selection, or ranking primitives.
Degree computation aggregates graph-neighborhood edges into a matrix-valued graph metric; add alone cannot represent the required graph indexing and neighborhood operation.
